historicalEras.name: 2008 Global Financial Crisis & V-Recovery
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Extreme macro deflation, Lehman collapse (-60% NIFTY drawdown) and 2009 general election V-reversal (+17% in 1 day)

historicalEras.name: 2010-2011 European Debt Crisis & Inflation Shock
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Double-digit CPI inflation in India, aggressive RBI repo rate hiking cycle, Greece/PIIGS sovereign default risk

historicalEras.name: 2012-2014 Taper Tantrum & Modi 1.0 Rally
historicalEras.regimeDescription: US Fed taper announcement, INR plunge to 68/USD, current account deficit crisis, followed by 2014 BJP majority election rally

historicalEras.name: 2015-2016 Commodity Slowdown & Demonetization
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Crude oil collapse, China Yuan devaluation shock, Nov 2016 Indian currency demonetization liquidity disruption

historicalEras.name: 2017-2019 GST Rollout & IL&FS Liquidity Shock
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Goods and Services Tax introduction, 2017 midcap mania, September 2018 IL&FS default triggering systemic shadow-banking credit crunch

historicalEras.name: 2020 COVID-19 Crash & Rapid Liquidity Recovery
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Global lockdown, NIFTY 38.4% crash in 30 days, Yes Bank RBI moratorium, followed by zero-rate global central bank stimulus explosion

historicalEras.name: 2021-2024 Retail Expansion, Global Inflation & Capex Boom
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Record domestic retail investor inflows, 2022 Russia-Ukraine war and global central bank rate tightening, followed by infrastructure capex expansion

historicalEras.name: 2025-2026 Frozen Out-of-Sample Holdout
historicalEras.regimeDescription: Untouched final out-of-sample holdout period reserved strictly for unseen evaluation
